public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each name in names
    let listed: List of Text be dependencies.get(name) otherwise []
    for each dep in listed
      if not dependencies.contains_key(dep) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: name, depends_on: dep)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable placed: List of Text be []
  let mutable pending be names
  repeat until pending.is_empty()
    let mutable chosen: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in pending
      let needed: List of Text be dependencies.get(candidate) otherwise []
      let blocked be for each dep in needed any not placed.contains(dep)
      if not blocked then
        set chosen to candidate
        break
      end
    end
    match chosen
      when some(step) then
        set placed to placed.append(step)
        set pending to for each other in pending where other is not step collect other
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: pending)
    end
  end
  return placed
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let names be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  for each name in names
    let wanted be dependencies.get(name) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {name}"
    for each need in wanted
      if not dependencies.contains_key(need) then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: name, depends_on: need)
      end
    end
  end

  let mutable ordered: List of Text be []
  let mutable remaining: List of Text be names
  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable next: maybe Text be nothing
    for each candidate in remaining
      let wanted be dependencies.get(candidate) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {candidate}"
      let is_ready be for each need in wanted all ordered.contains(need)
      if is_ready then
        set next to candidate
        break
      end
    end
    match next
      when some(chosen) then
        set ordered to ordered.append(chosen)
        set remaining to for each other in remaining where other is not chosen collect other
      when nothing then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end
  end
  return ordered
end
